instruction: A candid outdoor photograph captured from a wide-angle, eye-level perspective in a sunny, grassy park. On the left side of the frame, the woman in the gray t-shirt and green pants (R1) is positioned on a black yoga mat, holding a Warrior II pose while looking to the left. To her right, the bearded man in the dark green t-shirt and gray shorts (R2) stands on a separate black mat, performing the same Warrior II yoga pose and looking in the same direction. The two practice their yoga routine side-by-side in unison. Bright, natural afternoon daylight illuminates the entire scene, casting soft shadows on the green grass.
elements: R1 is the woman holding a Warrior II yoga pose on her own black yoga mat while R2 is the bearded man holding the same pose on a separate mat
